name: Cards
summary: Eight meaning cards for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Cards), built on the Card anatomy (cover, title, body, actions) with the marketing radius: Testimonial, Case study, Template, Info, Step, Stat, Article and Integration. Framework-free HTML and CSS, bound to the shared --aha-* tokens. Each type has its own copyable snippet; linked types use one stretched link over the whole card.
highlights: Eight card types on one page, each with its own paste-and-run snippet
Built on the Card anatomy (cover, title, body, actions) with the marketing radius and marketing type scale; not the aha-card web component
Whole card is one link (stretched-link pattern) on Case study, Template, Info, Article and Integration; Testimonial, Stat and Step are static
Hover lift only on linked cards, a visible focus ring around the whole card, and no motion under reduced motion
16:9 template thumbnails, 3:2 case-study and article covers; neutral placeholders until a real image replaces the media block
Grid steps from three columns to two at 991px and to one at 767px; padding tightens at 479px
